title: ATHLETE PROGRAM
author: Luke N.
desc: This program is built to increase strength whilst also building speed and power. This is done by performing strength based exercises supersetted with plyometrics such as box jumps.

ss.note:
Perform warm up at lighter weights and work way up to working sets

Chest tall, feet wide, toes wide, bum out.

SLOW ON WAY DOWN & FAST ON WAY UP
Start seated on box, hands on hips. Lean back slightly and lift feet off floor then Slam your feet on floor and jump as high as possible

ex.note:
Perform warm up sets at lighter weight to work towards working sets

Feet stand natural, shoulder width apart, hinge at hips, back straight & chest tall, push bum to back of room, keep bar close

Step out away from bench. Foot goes back on the bench, on the edge. Dropping down and slightly going back. KNEE INLINE WITH ANKLE!! Push through heel when driving back up

6 REPS EACH LEG

Perform with partner or of Lat pull down seat. 

When in position, SLOWLY lean forwards with chest and hips together. Try resist just falling over and come down as slow as you can
TOES FACE UP TO CEILING AT ALL TIMES!! Fast on the way down and nice and slow on the way up to create as much tension as possible
Start as kneeling a yard back from sled. Leaning over front leg, explode forward into the sled and perform 3-5 steps at full speed pushing the sled. alternate legs after every rep

ss.note:
WARM UP FIRST!!! 
Take off the rack and ALWAYS START WITH BAR ON THE GUARDS!! As quick as possible, push the bar up from chest level. Slowly bring it back down to rest on the guards, only for 1-3 secs

These push ups can either be normal push ups or hand release push ups.

Hand release push ups-Chest to floor, hands come off floor, then quickly push back up to starting position

ex.note: Start with the bar by our shoulders, then SLIGHTLY dipping with your knees, push up and straighten legs simultaneously pushing the bar up above head. Hold at the top for 3 secs and slowly bring down

WARM UP TO WORKING WEIGHTS FIRST

Chest parallel to floor, legs slightly bent, bar starts on floor then bring the bar up to chest as quickly as you can then relax as bar comes down.

ss.note:
This can be done either with or without weights/assistance

KEEP CHEST TALL AND BRING ELBOWS TO HIPS WHEN PULLING UP.

This can be done either with or without weights/assistance

LEAN CHEST OVER WHEN DIPPING DOWN, KEEP EBLOWS 90°s WHEN DIPPING DOWN, FULLY EXTEND AT TOP OF DIP
Slightly hinging hips over toes, knees slightly bent, elbows locked by your side and don’t ever move. Pushing the rope down by your side and splitting it apart at the bottom of movement
Standing tall, palms facing in front of you, keep elbows locked beside your and they don’t move, bring dumbbells up as far as you can before elbows move from side, SLOWLY bring weight back down

ex.note:
This can be done either on a treadmill or a bike, 

Bike-keep speed at around 80-95RPM or a max of 135BPM

Treadmill-easy and light 5km run within 35 mins and 0.0 incline
KEEP ARMS FULLY STRAIGHT THE WHOLE TIME AND TRY NOT TO ROUND YOUR BACK OR TWIST YOUR TORSO
THE SLOWER THE BETTER!! This can be done with a resistance band or on a cable machine. Start with handle in centre of chest and slowly extend arms out in front and don’t let the weight pull you !!!
KEEP BACK AGAINST THE BACKREST THE WHOLE TIME! Focus on slow on the way down
Keep hips inline with chest, don’t stick bum out on the way down

Tempo work - 3 secs on the way down

Start at top of movement and keep elbows slightly tucked in, not fully out. Drive feet into floor

ss.note:
Tempo work - 3 secs on the way down

Back straight against the bench,
Starting above head. Elbows don’t go below 90°. Drive feet into floor when pushing up

DRIVE WITH EBLOWS NOT WRISTS!

These can be done either sitting or standing, either or is fine. Try not to swing so much and drive through elbows

ex.note:
Tempo work - 3 secs on the way down

Keep chest tall, don’t hunch over when pressing. Keep hands close in, not far apart on the handles

This can be done either with or without weights/assistance

KEEP CHEST TALL AND BRING ELBOWS TO HIPS WHEN PULLING UP.

ELBOWS TO POCKET!!

Hands a little wider than shoulder width apart holding the bar. Mainly pull through pinky fingers and pull bar to chin/chest level. Keep chest up right
Holding the rope knuckles up, drive your elbows back at the same height as your shoulders. Drive through elbows not wrists/hands
Standing tall, palms facing in front of you, keep elbows locked beside your and they don’t move, bring dumbbells up as far as you can before elbows move from side, SLOWLY bring weight back down

ss.note: Slightly hinging hips over toes, knees slightly bent, elbows locked by your side and don’t ever move. Pushing the rope down by your side and splitting it apart at the bottom of movement

These push ups can either be normal push ups or hand release push ups.

Hand release push ups-Chest to floor, hands come off floor, then quickly push back up to starting position

ex.note:
Work your way up to these sets by performing lower weighted sets

Keep back straight, heels on the floor the whole time and brace your stomach just before squatting.

Perform warm up sets at lighter weight to work towards working sets

Feet stand natural, shoulder width apart, hinge at hips, back straight & chest tall, push bum to back of room, keep bar close
Keep toes pointed up at all times when extending legs out. Slowly bring the weight down once fully extended. Explode up and extend legs as quick as you can

Perform with partner or of Lat pull down seat. 

When in position, SLOWLY lean forwards with chest and hips together. Try resist just falling over and come down as slow as you can
This can be done with any sort of weights, barbell, kettlebells, dumbbells etc. when taking a step forward, make this step a casual step. Push through heels when coming up from the bottom of a lunge
If this can’t be done due to the machine not being at your gym then place a heavy kettlebell on your knee and calf raise exactly the same way as you would normally

Take off the rack and ALWAYS START WITH BAR ON THE GUARDS!! As quick as possible, push the bar up from chest level. Slowly bring it back down to rest on the guards, only for 1-3 secs

These push ups can either be normal push ups or hand release push ups.

Hand release push ups-Chest to floor, hands come off floor, then quickly push back up to starting position

ex.note: Start with the bar by our shoulders, then SLIGHTLY dipping with your knees, push up and straighten legs simultaneously pushing the bar up above head. Hold at the top for 3 secs and slowly bring down

WARM UP TO WORKING WEIGHTS FIRST

Chest parallel to floor, legs slightly bent, bar starts on floor then bring the bar up to chest as quickly as you can then relax as bar comes down.

ss.note:
This can be done either with or without weights/assistance

KEEP CHEST TALL AND BRING ELBOWS TO HIPS WHEN PULLING UP.

This can be done either with or without weights/assistance

LEAN CHEST OVER WHEN DIPPING DOWN, KEEP EBLOWS 90°s WHEN DIPPING DOWN, FULLY EXTEND AT TOP OF DIP
Slightly hinging hips over toes, knees slightly bent, elbows locked by your side and don’t ever move. Pushing the rope down by your side and splitting it apart at the bottom of movement
Standing tall, palms facing in front of you, keep elbows locked beside your and they don’t move, bring dumbbells up as far as you can before elbows move from side, SLOWLY bring weight back down

ex.note:
This can be done either on a treadmill or a bike, 

Bike-keep speed at around 80-95RPM or a max of 135BPM

Treadmill-easy and light 5km run within 35 mins and 0.0 incline
KEEP ARMS FULLY STRAIGHT THE WHOLE TIME AND TRY NOT TO ROUND YOUR BACK OR TWIST YOUR TORSO
THE SLOWER THE BETTER!! This can be done with a resistance band or on a cable machine. Start with handle in centre of chest and slowly extend arms out in front and don’t let the weight pull you !!!
KEEP BACK AGAINST THE BACKREST THE WHOLE TIME! Focus on slow on the way down
Keep hips inline with chest, don’t stick bum out on the way down

Tempo work - 3 secs on the way down

Start at top of movement and keep elbows slightly tucked in, not fully out. Drive feet into floor

ss.note:
Tempo work - 3 secs on the way down

Back straight against the bench,
Starting above head. Elbows don’t go below 90°. Drive feet into floor when pushing up

DRIVE WITH EBLOWS NOT WRISTS!

These can be done either sitting or standing, either or is fine. Try not to swing so much and drive through elbows

ex.note:
Tempo work - 3 secs on the way down

Keep chest tall, don’t hunch over when pressing. Keep hands close in, not far apart on the handles

This can be done either with or without weights/assistance

KEEP CHEST TALL AND BRING ELBOWS TO HIPS WHEN PULLING UP.

ELBOWS TO POCKET!!

Hands a little wider than shoulder width apart holding the bar. Mainly pull through pinky fingers and pull bar to chin/chest level. Keep chest up right
Holding the rope knuckles up, drive your elbows back at the same height as your shoulders. Drive through elbows not wrists/hands
Standing tall, palms facing in front of you, keep elbows locked beside your and they don’t move, bring dumbbells up as far as you can before elbows move from side, SLOWLY bring weight back down

ss.note: Slightly hinging hips over toes, knees slightly bent, elbows locked by your side and don’t ever move. Pushing the rope down by your side and splitting it apart at the bottom of movement

These push ups can either be normal push ups or hand release push ups.

Hand release push ups-Chest to floor, hands come off floor, then quickly push back up to starting position

ex.note:
Work your way up to these sets by performing lower weighted sets

Keep back straight, heels on the floor the whole time and brace your stomach just before squatting.

Perform warm up sets at lighter weight to work towards working sets

Feet stand natural, shoulder width apart, hinge at hips, back straight & chest tall, push bum to back of room, keep bar close
Keep toes pointed up at all times when extending legs out. Slowly bring the weight down once fully extended. Explode up and extend legs as quick as you can

Perform with partner or of Lat pull down seat. 

When in position, SLOWLY lean forwards with chest and hips together. Try resist just falling over and come down as slow as you can
This can be done with any sort of weights, barbell, kettlebells, dumbbells etc. when taking a step forward, make this step a casual step. Push through heels when coming up from the bottom of a lunge
If this can’t be done due to the machine not being at your gym then place a heavy kettlebell on your knee and calf raise exactly the same way as you would normally

ss.note:
Perform warm up at lighter weights and work way up to working sets

Chest tall, feet wide, toes wide, bum out.

SLOW ON WAY DOWN & FAST ON WAY UP
Start seated on box, hands on hips. Lean back slightly and lift feet off floor then Slam your feet on floor and jump as high as possible

ex.note:
Perform warm up sets at lighter weight to work towards working sets

Feet stand natural, shoulder width apart, hinge at hips, back straight & chest tall, push bum to back of room, keep bar close

Step out away from bench. Foot goes back on the bench, on the edge. Dropping down and slightly going back. KNEE INLINE WITH ANKLE!! Push through heel when driving back up

6 REPS EACH LEG

Perform with partner or of Lat pull down seat. 

When in position, SLOWLY lean forwards with chest and hips together. Try resist just falling over and come down as slow as you can
TOES FACE UP TO CEILING AT ALL TIMES!! Fast on the way down and nice and slow on the way up to create as much tension as possible
Start as kneeling a yard back from sled. Leaning over front leg, explode forward into the sled and perform 3-5 steps at full speed pushing the sled. alternate legs after every rep
